== English errata comparison sources ==
The Supplement changes the two-Force bribe to exclusion from battle. Both English faces read “captain in the Cloud City Wing Guard”. The second article had transcribed that phrase as “captain of”. The Supplement identifies the Cloud City trooper characteristic outside game text.

Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary Supplement.pdf#page=8|Glossary Supplement]], updated 29 January 2002, PDF page 8. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 5. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=5|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 5. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=132|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 132. [[:File:CC-D-trooperjerrolblendin.gif|Complete replacement face]]. The printed article retains its existing documentary identifier 5_103o. Its explicit GEMP display field is blank because the pinned Guild directory and mapping lack that class and alias.
